title: Leap Year Solution
summary: Translates the leap year flowchart into nested if statements using the modulo operator, one decision per nesting level.

concepts.heading: From flowchart to nested ifs
points: Each question in the flowchart becomes an if; each answer path becomes a branch.
Modulo (%) returns the remainder of a division, so year % 4 === 0 means 'divides cleanly by 4'.
Level 1: if year % 4 === 0 continue; else return "Not leap year.".
Level 2 (inside level 1): if year % 100 === 0 continue; else return "Leap year.".
Level 3 (inside level 2): if year % 400 === 0 return "Leap year."; else return "Not leap year.".
Every path ends in a return with the exact required string.
Going from the written rules to code is a big jump; the flowchart is the stepping stone, and the logic is the hard part.

concepts.heading: Compact alternative
points: (Extra) The reference repo collapses the logic into one condition: (year % 4 === 0 && year % 100 !== 0) || year % 400 === 0. It is equivalent but denser to read.

task.name: Leap Year (solution)
task.starting_point: Function receiving year with the flowchart as a guide.
steps: Check year % 4 === 0; otherwise return Not leap year.
Inside, check year % 100 === 0; otherwise return Leap year.
Inside that, check year % 400 === 0 to choose between the two results.
Run the course's check and confirm all tests pass.
task.expected_result: 2000 and 2024 give Leap year.; 1900 and 2023 give Not leap year.
